work-productivity-ontology-typed-workflow-helper 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Introduces a skill for building and improving ontology-style workflows for work productivity use cases, based on validated user demand.
- Guides users through restating requirements, creating actionable plans or checklists, and producing local-hardware-friendly implementations.
- Emphasizes rapid, reliable workflow and artifact generation tailored to user inputs and practical constraints.
- Provides triggers and examples for recognizing when the skill is relevant.
- Includes built-in validation and verification steps for delivered outputs.
